build_gan_module: build a GAN module with a discriminator and generator network using DeepMind cs_gan
connect_gan_network: connect the GAN discriminator and generator to compute losses and debug ops
compute_generator_loss: compute the generator loss as a cross-entropy error function for latent optimization
build_optimization_components: build optimization components for discriminator and generator losses with variable separation
get_gan_variables: get the discriminator and generator variables from a GAN module for training
